gaps.title: Generic WIS vs North American power ratings
missing_inputs: Locate matching country/ECU-calibration factory sheet, test convention and revision for B235R 250 vs US 260 EEC.
gaps.reason: Ratings differ, and engine code alone is insufficient to choose the correct configuration record.
